name: Direct Prompt Injection
summary: Untrusted user input attempts to alter instruction priority or application behavior.

name: Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Instructions embedded in retrieved or external content influence the model or agent.

name: Jailbreak / Safety Boundary Manipulation
summary: Adversarial inputs attempt to elicit behavior outside intended safety or policy boundaries.

name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
summary: Model or application reveals sensitive information beyond authorization.

name: Model Extraction / Theft
summary: Adversary attempts to recover model behavior, intellectual property or weights.

name: Data or Model Poisoning
summary: Adversarial changes to data or model artifacts influence future behavior.

name: RAG Knowledge Poisoning
summary: Malicious or manipulated corpus content changes retrieval-driven behavior.

name: Agent Tool Misuse
summary: An agent is induced to use an authorized tool outside intended purpose or context.

name: Memory / Context Poisoning
summary: Persistent or session context is manipulated to influence later decisions.

name: Model Source Tampering
summary: Model code, weights or serving artifacts are replaced or modified without authorization.

name: AI Software Supply Chain Compromise
summary: Packages, CI/CD, gateways, frameworks or registries used by AI systems are compromised.

name: Coding-Agent Dependency Manipulation
summary: Package metadata or documentation is shaped to influence automated dependency selection by coding agents.

name: Runtime LLM Command Generation
summary: Malware or tooling queries an LLM at runtime to generate host-specific commands or logic.

name: AI-Assisted Reconnaissance and Social Engineering
summary: LLMs accelerate OSINT synthesis, target profiling, translation or social-engineering content.

name: Agentic Attack Orchestration
summary: AI agents autonomously chain multiple cyber tasks with limited human intervention.

name: AI Gateway Credential Compromise
summary: An AI gateway or proxy is compromised to access concentrated upstream model-provider credentials.
